item.title: Transportation Management and Overtourism: Habits, Perspectives, Policies and Strategies
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines the intersection of transportation management and overtourism, exploring how mobility systems interact with destination capacity and visitor volumes. The collection seeks to advance understanding of transportation's role in managing tourist flows and mitigating the negative effects of excessive visitation at popular destinations.

Appel publié par Research in Transportation Business & Management. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
